name: bg-card-dance
title: Card-Dance Background — tiled photo wave (AE card dance)
description: Seamless looping background: one image sliced into a tile grid; a traveling wavefront makes tiles pop toward the viewer with combined tilt, brightness ripple and micro-shift (AE Card Dance look). The same image, dimmed, backs the grid so lifted tiles never expose bare background. 12s loop, cut anywhere. Landscape 16:9 twin of bg-card-dance-portrait (grid transposes, never cropped).
